decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - A method statement for making good all external walls where mortar is to be removed and repointed shall be submitted and a sample agreed in writing by the Local Authority before commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Full details of the works to the parquet floor, windows and details of the new slates and ridge tiles shall be submitted and agreed in writing by the Local Authority before commencement of works and the approved details shall be implemented and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 5 - The chemical injection works to the DPC and the erection of plasterboard to the underside of the rafters shall not be undertaken, unless agreed on site and in writing by the Local Authority.

Condition : 6 - The developer shall afford access at all reasonable times to a representative of the Kew Bridge Steam Museum, as nominated by the Local Planning, and shall allow them to observe and record the building as necessary.
description: Works to Gate House including removal  and replacement of slate roof & lead work, external and internal decoration (Listed Building Consent)
